button.label: Button
button.guide_desc: Guidelines for choosing and implementing the correct button type for your interface.
button.priority_weighting: A matrix describing when to use Primary, Secondary, or Tertiary buttons.
button.semantics_desc: Buttons trigger actions, while Links change page location or scroll position.
button.semantics_guide_ref: Refer to the Link vs Button guide for more detailed information.
button.standard_desc: Standard rectangular button for general actions.
button.standard_usage: Main CTAs like Submit, Save, or Add Item.
button.icon_usage: Dense toolbars, media controls, or social sharing.
button.link_desc: A button styled like a text link for secondary navigating actions.
button.group_desc: A container that groups multiple logically related buttons together.
button.group_usage: Filter bars, pagination, or multi-step form actions.
button.copy_desc: A specialized button for copying text to the clipboard with visual feedback.
button.copy_usage: API keys, transaction IDs, or sharing links.
button.consistency_desc: Maintain identical label casing (Sentence case) and icon placement across all buttons.
button.placement_desc: Buttons should be grouped at the bottom-right for modals or bottom-left for forms.
button.placement_conflict_desc: Avoid placing multiple primary buttons on the same view.

btn.page_transition: Standard page transitions or footer links.
